title: [Pre Order] AYN Thor Base 8GB+128GB US$320.16 (~A$450) with PayPal Delivered @ AYN Official Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: [Pre Order] AYN Thor Base 8GB+128GB US$320.16 (~A$450) with PayPal Delivered @ AYN Official Store AliExpress

[Clear] Literally just commented in coupon post tagging our resident expert RichardL. I think this is amazing value.
[despavr] With the 35% TCB UK it is an insane deal indeed!
[RichardL] I purchased a Pro model second hand before the price increase and the UFS downgrade.
[bhunter101] Can I play fortnight on this one? Will it handle it? Good graphics?
[despavr] I'm not sure about region restrictions for Fortnite but online it looks like heaps of people can run the game on the android apk at 120fps no problem
[rk1314] yes it can. I have one and though I don't play fortnight, it's more than capable enough to run it fluidly.
[DONMAI] insane deal and combo. dont even want one but bargainosity makes me want to jump in.
Possibly worth the other models as well, if calcs are right,
16gb ram, 512gb model comes to about $470 shipped
16tb ram, 1tb model comes to about $575 shipped
[despavr] I don't condone reselling but since the wait is usually a month or two, you can probably sell it on fb marketplace really quickly to keen buyers if you don't end up wanting it
[dlovep] 16tb ram, 1tb model comes to about $575 shipped
It is insane to have 16tb ram for $575… but reality you get is 16 GB
[Kermitanz] I just ordered an AYN Odin 3 last week so just a heads up for those interested, there's quite a shipping backlog with these two products with the general guidance being expect a 2 month wait from Order > Delivery - they've been struggling to keep up with demand from what I've read.
[despavr] Those wanting the Max 16GB + 512GB
Charged $652 AUD by aliexpress after coupon code and PayPal deal (conversion by revolut)
TopCashBack UK 35% tracked at £113.45 which is roughly $215 AUD
Brings total to $437 AUD when its $499 USD with shipping direct from AYN, which is $700 AUD
So from $700 AUD to $437 AUD.
Also tracked 15 USD aliexpress cashback from joining team OZB, so pretty close to $400 aud making it almost $300 AUD off.
[Qmar] so you clicked through the topcashback website, then used the Australian coupon and paid in AUD?
[despavr] Yes click through TCB UK, and you can pay in any currency. I pay in USD personally as the exchange on aliexpress isn’t too amazing but will work either way
[tonyamazing] 464.55 USD converted to 686.58 AUD via CommBank
Hopefully the TopCashBack comes through, I've never used them.
Edit: I might have forgotten to pay in USD in PayPal … so PayPal did the conversion, not CommBank 🤦‍♂️
Edit 2: 113.71 GBP cash back confirmed.
[succccus] @tonyamazing: damn. more than an hour for me :/ nervous since first time using topcashback uk
[despavr] It converted to $652 aud for me with revolut. It’s worth having one, especially as you’d probably need it anyway to withdraw the GBP from topcashback. Not sure if this is allowed but if you need a referral link let me know!
[tonyamazing] I linked my PayPal for future withdraw. I haven't checked what cut they take.
It's not the OzBargain way, but I CBF chasing further discounts.
[corgi-runner] None of those coupon codes are working for me.
EDIT: Am an idiot. Ignore me.
[augernised] quick 10min review if you've literally never seen this before or what its capable of - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I7YD042Seb4
[DannyBoy] Shit, hats off to anyone that can make it through those 10 minutes listening to that guy
[TheFBIGuy] Ughh. Really don't know if i should get this or the Odin 3. So tempted by both.
[ce5himm] If you don't need dual screen, definitely o3
[despavr] Depends, i have the odin 2 portal and i bought one of these because i want a true fit-in-your-pocket / bag experience
[despavr] You download emulators, and then you download rom files of games for the type of emulator. Of course, you have to obtain these roms in one of many ways, but i can only recommend legally.
You can also just download games from the play store but no one really buys these for that
[xpllmmff] What's the point of spending hundreds on one of these dedicated Android "console " when you can get emulator installed on your phone and play the same retro game for free 🤔?
I know this looks more like a a real deal rather than a swiping on tablet glasses. But with additional dozens of dollars on a retractable controller, phone users can still enjoy the very same handling just as gamepad dose,
[despavr] Ifyour only metric is “can I get the same ROM running for free,” then sure, you’ve discovered the cheapest possible option. Congratulations! This product isn’t for you
[bboarder] You're not really wrong. Rather spend the money to upgrade to a gaming phone and not have to worry about carrying, charging, and updating two devices. Screen size and controller build quality is the main difference if it matters.
[TheFBIGuy] The problem is, even the best gaming phone, the Red Magic 11 Pro, can barely handle gaming. Despite their cool liquid cooling, thermal throttling is still a huge issue with these phones. Sure, you can get an external cooler, but then you've got a phone and a cooler and you may as well have just bought one of these handhelds.
[Dotaman] I purchased this during the very first batch. Have had it for about 12 months now and it's still works perfectly. I had an issue with the fan but messaged AYN about it and they sent a replacement fan the very next day . Hinge has been perfect so far
[dottjt] I decided on getting the RP6 instead. Same internals etc. and obviously won't have the form factor for ds/3ds but it's also waayyyyy cheaper + I feel if I was going to play ds/3ds, I'd just use an original console.
But, just my opinion.
[despavr] I bought a nice and cheap used 3ds xl here in Japan, but i realised if i bought one of these for the same cost, i would get upscaling, save states and also just way easier to manage and download roms. So i ended up selling it to buy one of these!
You do miss out on the 3ds screen and stylus experience though
[dottjt] Yeah, there's pros and cons to both. I think the different stylus experience is what turns me off the Thor, like it's just different tech. Depends on what games you're playing though.
[serpserpserp] Stylus experience on the Thor is lacking unfortunately
[SeanConnery] If only the RP6 was a 6 inch screen as well. That half inch smaller is a dealbreaker for me.
[dottjt] Oh really, why's that?
I actually wish that the device was a bit smaller, because it's not quite pocketable.
[gcheap] Yeah good call. The Thor doesn't really reproduce the DS/3DS experience. So I'd do the same, just get a 3DS. You don't get the second screen but that's ok, you don't need to watch videos while playing games
[gcheap] Considered this and the Odin but I know I wouldn't use it for a while, I have a few other devices I'm already using so it wouldn't be right. Would be a while before it gets delivered too. Really good deal though, the price alone was very tempting but I finally realised I was just making up reasons to buy it. There will be another cashback/discount combo like this down the line for something that I want like the next Odin or Thor or Retroid and I won't have to try so hard.
[Sarquiss] Thank you. Been eyeing a Thor was a while now but couldn’t justify the price. Preordered a Max 16GB Ram/512GB SSD.
$662.93 was the total. TopCashBack UK 35% tracked at roughly $215 AUD, for a total of $447.93 - this is what I was looking to pay for a New Nintendo 3DS XL with IPS screens.
[bingohah] how did you make it to AU$662 for 16GB/512GB? It shows $750 to me..
Edit: got it. need to pay by paypal.
[FraddyFezbear] Hi, I'm slightly confused on how to achieve the best price. How do you use the UK Cashback specifically? Aren't these Australian codes? (also, the codes don't seem to be working, saying it's below the minimum price or already used/incorrect)
[despavr] As confirmed by @Clear , you can use the australian codes and pay in any currency on Aliexpress as long as you click through the TCB UK button
[FraddyFezbear] Ah ok. Also, the last code seems to be used up, and the first code tells me it's below minimum price?
[despavr] I’m not too sure, i’d just copy whatever the code is showing for you on the listing page, it should show the best one under the price depending on the variant you choose, and then apply it at checkout if it isn’t done automatically.
Not sure if these codes are limited use and can be exhausted by others
[FraddyFezbear] @despavr: Thanks for your help, think I’ve got it figured out. Banger deal, now just deciding whether I need an Odin or not :)
[Ehx] How long did it take for cashback to track?
[despavr] 4x purchases over the last 2 deals and always tracked in under 10 minutes
[Ehx] Been about 10 minutes, so far. Got nothing tracked :S. Worried.
My process:
TCBUK Clicked aliexpress > searched for ayn official store > opened item> paid
[Ehx] @succccus: i refunded, I'm not risking it.
[JustWantToSave] Under 10 minutes usually.
But sometimes it can take an hour or two on the very odd/rare occasion.
[dui2705] purchased over an hour ago and no cash back yet. says it could take up to 7 days but seeing everyone post 10-15 mins has got me nervous
[RichardL] TIP for anyone purchasing.
Since it's a pre-order, I would recommend " Extend delivery date " after you purchase to prevent AliExpress from auto-cancelling your order.
[vlahka] Its definitely worth going for the pro model by default on any AYN system if you want to play the higher systems well. I still have my older AYN Odin. The thing is still a beast and playing all those older systems and arcade games using a pair of VR glasses is delicious.
[rk1314] I have one since the first batch. Also have the newest Nova from Retroid. IMO the Thor is probably THE handheld to get still. It is not that comfortable for long sessions due to how close the controls are to the sides though (a grip will fix it).
[RichardL] How's the Retroid Pocket Nova?
Was considering picking on up to replace my Odin 2. Wanted a smaller handheld with a 4:3 OLED Screen.
[serpserpserp] If those are you use cases, then you won't be disappointed
[rk1314] There's nothing available right now with a better 4:3 screen though it does need tweaking as the colours are over saturated out of the box.
For me personally, I'm not sure I want to keep it as the Thor is just more versatile and they are both around the same size overall with the Nova being lighter. It is more comfortable though. I will be going on a trip next week and was 100% going to bring the Nova this time around to see how I like it but honestly, after receiving it I'm still more inclined to use my Thor. Might end up selling in a few weeks.
[RichardL] Thanks for the input, might hold off getting the Nova since I also have the Thor.
[Goodvibesguy88] Is it just me or do none of these coupon codes work?
[191919] having issues as well, is there any way to check if the cashback tracking is working? or are you supposed to use these codes in aliexpress for the cashback? i am dumb
[FireHemlock] If you clicked through TopCashback, it should track within 10-15mins and show up in your account. If it still hasn't shown up, you can click the Aliexpress link through TCB again, and then check the box "I made a purchase" and then wait 10-15mins and see if it comes through.
[191919] thanks! so if my aliexpress final fee is 450-460 or whatever, thats the right amount to pay? then hopefully id get another 150 back from topcashback if i've clicked through correctly, and dont need to worry about any other aliexpress codes?
[FireHemlock] @191919: I can't be sure unless I see the breakdown, but you can reference my post just a few threads down where I break down my purchase.
At a high level yes, if you paid $450 on Ali and your cashback is tracked, you should receive roughly $157.5* in your TCB account in about 11 weeks.
*sometimes the cashback calculation excludes tax etc. so figure might vary a little.
[TheFBIGuy] @FireHemlock: Yeah, unfortunately i got stuffed. I paid 486 usd but it must not've counted taxes and shipping and such because it tracked the purchase as 335gbp and the est cashback is 117.14
[FireHemlock] @TheFBIGuy: Just checked mine and TCB tracked AU$665.30 equivalent (instead of the $740 I paid), so the cashback must've excluded tax.
[FireHemlock] If you don't really play NDS/3DS games, and/or you want to emulate a larger library of PC games via GameNative/Gamehub, then you'd want Odin 3.
If you prefer clamshell design (easier to transport around with minimum case), want to play NDS/3DS, want to multi-task across two screens (game on top, guide on bottom etc.), then get the AYN Thor. For the Thor you don't really need more than 12GB RAM, as even with 16GB RAM it won't run the harder AAA PC games as well as Odin 3.
[dui2705] thanks mate I ended up getting the Thor pro model as I do have a decent gaming pc and might just stream via Apollo to play the demanding games.
[FireHemlock] Ordered Odin 3 Max.
RRP $768.39
Cashback: - $232.89
Ali Coupon: -$72.00
Paypal Discount: -$60.00
Tax: +$79.47
Shipping: +$26.34
OzB Cashback: -$38.42
Final total after cashback:
AU $470.89
I missed out on the last two times this happened so I didn't have the state of mind to switch to USD, otherwise I'd say another $30-35 on top.
If the Odin 3 Portal does come out end of year, I can at least sell this to break even on the new RAM/Snapdragon tax. 🥶
[rk1314] how did you get that cashback? I'm thinking of getting an odin too to replace my other devices.
[FireHemlock] The first cashback is the TopCashBack one, outlined in OP's description. Second cashback IIRC a few weeks ago you could join the OzBargain group on Aliexpress which gets you 5% cashback on most purchases.
[Dotaman] It's right in the middle. Plays 3ds games upscaled but also can handle some PC games. My 3ds is collecting dust since I purchased this but also don't expect to run games kingdom hearts 3 without this turning into a a firepit
[Panama] Gonna regret not pulling the trigger, but i suspect Retroid’s dual screen device is around the corner and will likely have a 4:3 oled bottom screen as per the Nova.
[RichardL] Retroid and AYN has the same parent company - Moorechip Technologies.
Retroid Dual Screen is rumoured for second half of the year release
Will probably be a cheaper/less powerful AYN Thor.
Usually AYN is their premium brand and Retroid is the cheaper/budget brand.
[gcheap] Hmm less powerful? You think they would go weaker than 8 gen 2 after the 6 and Nova?
[RichardL] Good point.
Forgot that the RP6 and Nova are also on the SD8G2 (Nova is QCS8550, which is a SD8G2 without cellular).
Will probably be the same chipset then.
[gcheap] @RichardL: Yeah if they had a lot older 865s in stock I think they would have come out with a weaker/cheaper Nova like the Thor. So I think it would be the same chip at least going forward.
[FireHemlock] RP Nova is around AU $380 after shipping (with no discounts). The base 8GB AYN Thor here is actually much cheaper (~$300 according to OP), and will have a larger 6inch screen.
There is pretty much 0 chance that a dual screen Nova will cost less than $380.
[ortusern] The base model is not really worth it. It has a different chipset.
AYN Thor is by far my favourite emulation handheld. Highly recommended. Does everything including 3DS.I think even the PS3 emulator is starting to mature.
[RichardL] The base model is not really worth it. It has a different chipset.
Base, Pro & Max all have the same chipset - Snapdragon 8 Gen 2.
Lite is the different chipset - Snapdragon 865.
[despavr] That’s the lite and isn’t sold on the aliexpress store
[geshc] if i got a rog ally x z2 extreme, is this worth getting still? I'm getting FOMO seeing this deal.
Can this play PC games as well? (i.e. Hades 2, Slay the Spire)
[Dotaman] The Thor is amazing however The only thing Thor has above the rog is portability and 3DS games nothing else. It can play both those games well but most modern PC games will be running at 85 degrees or higher
[RichardL] Can this play PC games as well? (i.e. Hades 2, Slay the Spire)
Technically yes, through GameNative or GameHub.
But don't purchase the AYN Thor expecting to play PC Games.
[despavr] I’ve had that handheld and also the lenovo legion go’s, i sold all of them for an android with the same specs as this. Never looked back because of the portability and comfort of these versus those computer handhelds. And yes you’ll be able to run those games directly from your steam library with no performance issues. You will have trouble playing AAA games though.
